### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of the sarek output (csv/, reports/, variant_calling/, annotation/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC name of the assembly the run was aligned to (hg38, hg19, mm10): the axis and gene lane of every locus track. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`bcftools/stats_sections.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_sections.py) | The distribution blocks of `bcftools stats`, melted into one long frame. | `sample`, `caller`, `section`, `bin`, `label`, `count` |
| [`bcftools/stats_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_summary.py) | Per-sample, per-caller variant record counts from `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `n_records`, `n_no_alts`, `n_snps`, `n_mnps`, `n_indels`, `n_others`, `n_multiallelic_sites`, `n_multiallelic_snp_sites`, `snp_fraction`, `log10_n_records` |
| [`bcftools/stats_tstv.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_tstv.py) | Per-sample, per-caller transition/transversion ratio from `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `ts`, `tv`, `ts_tv`, `ts_1st_alt`, `tv_1st_alt`, `ts_tv_1st_alt` |
| [`mosdepth/regions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/regions.py) | Per-target mosdepth depth, binned into a genome-wide coverage track. | `chromosome`, `position`, `end`, `value`, `sample`, `stage`, `sample_stage`, `n_targets` |
| [`mosdepth/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/summary.py) | Per-contig coverage summary written by mosdepth. | `sample`, `stage`, `scope`, `chrom`, `length`, `bases`, `mean_depth`, `min_depth`, `max_depth` |
| [`mosdepth/xy_sex_check.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/xy_sex_check.py) | X and Y mean depth per library, and the sex the ratio is consistent with. | `sample`, `stage`, `x_coverage`, `y_coverage`, `xy_ratio`, `inferred_sex` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/callset_qc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.10.0/recipes/callset_qc.py) | One QC profile per callset (sample and caller), for a parallel-coordinates tile. | `callset`, `sample`, `caller`, `n_records`, `snp_fraction`, `ts_tv`, `multiallelic_pct`, `pass_pct`, `het_hom_ratio`, `median_dp`, `median_het_vaf` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/indel_spectrum.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.10.0/recipes/indel_spectrum.py) | Indel length spectrum per callset, from the `IDD` block of `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `callset`, `length`, `indel_class`, `count`, `fraction` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/mosdepth_targets.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.10.0/recipes/mosdepth_targets.py) | Per-target mosdepth depth, unbinned, for the Cohort QC locus section. | `chrom`, `pos`, `end`, `depth`, `sample`, `stage`, `sample_stage`, `target_bp` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/mosdepth_windows.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.10.0/recipes/mosdepth_windows.py) | The 1 Mb mosdepth windows under the column names the locus section shares. | `chrom`, `pos`, `end`, `depth`, `sample`, `stage`, `sample_stage`, `n_targets` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/recipes/samples.py) | One row per sarek sample, from the CSV manifests sarek publishes under csv/. | `sample_id`, `patient`, `sex`, `status`, `status_label`, `n_callers` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/substitution_spectrum.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.10.0/recipes/substitution_spectrum.py) | SNV substitution spectrum per callset, folded onto the six pyrimidine classes. | `sample`, `caller`, `callset`, `substitution_class`, `mutation_class`, `count`, `fraction` |
| [`snpeff/ann_variants.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/ann_variants.py) | One row per annotated variant call, read from SnpEff's annotated VCF. | `sample`, `caller`, `chrom`, `pos`, `variant_key`, `ref`, `alt`, `variant_type`, `qual`, `filter_status`, `is_pass`, `gt`, `dp`, `vaf`, `gene`, `gene_id`, `impact`, `consequence`, `hgvs_p`, `aa_pos` |
| [`snpeff/csv_stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/csv_stats.py) | The composition sections of SnpEff's CSV summary, melted into one long frame. | `sample`, `caller`, `section`, `category`, `count`, `percent` |
| [`snpeff/gene_heatmap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/gene_heatmap.py) | Gene by callset burden matrix, for a clustered heatmap. | `gene_name` |
| [`snpeff/gene_upset.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/gene_upset.py) | Gene-level caller overlap: one row per gene, one 0/1 column per caller. | `gene_name` |
| [`snpeff/genes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/genes.py) | Per-gene variant counts by impact class, from SnpEff's gene effect table. | `sample`, `caller`, `gene_name`, `gene_id`, `biotype`, `n_high`, `n_low`, `n_moderate`, `n_modifier`, `n_variants`, `n_coding` |
| [`snpeff/protein_lollipop.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/protein_lollipop.py) | Coding variants positioned along their protein, for a lollipop track. | `sample`, `caller`, `gene`, `aa_pos`, `impact`, `consequence`, `hgvs_p`, `variant_key`, `vaf` |
| [`snpeff/variant_upset.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/snpeff/variant_upset.py) | Variant-level caller overlap: one row per variant, one 0/1 column per caller. | `variant_key` |
| [`vcf/variants.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/vcf/variants.py) | One row per variant call, read from the VCFs themselves. | `sample`, `caller`, `chrom`, `pos`, `variant_key`, `ref`, `alt`, `variant_type`, `qual`, `filter_status`, `is_pass`, `gt`, `dp`, `vaf` |
| [`vcftools/filter_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/vcftools/filter_summary.py) | How a caller's own FILTER column partitions its calls. | `sample`, `caller`, `filter_label`, `n_variants`, `n_ts`, `n_tv`, `ts_tv`, `is_pass`, `pct_of_calls` |
| [`vcftools/tstv_qual.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/vcftools/tstv_qual.py) | Transition/transversion ratio as a function of the quality floor. | `sample`, `caller`, `series`, `qual_threshold`, `n_ts_above`, `n_tv_above`, `ts_tv_above` |
